calls.stated_price: ~$6 current; near-term fair value ~$12 (3.2x P/S on 2026E $1.02B rev); bull ~$20 (4x P/S on 2027E ~$1.4B rev)
calls.thesis: Genius Sports is the critical data + AI (Genius IQ) infrastructure layer across the $100B+ sports economy: official league data feeds sportsbooks, leagues/teams, broadcasters, advertisers (174 new advertisers in Q2 incl. McDonald's, Airbnb, YouTube TV) and prediction markets (Kalshi, Polymarket). Flywheel: more data -> more partners -> more engagement -> more ad value. Revenue +25% CAGR over 3y, OCF $86M in 2025, WS expects >$1B 2026 sales (+51%).
calls.base_case: ~$12/share on 2026E $1.02B sales at his 5-year average 3.2x P/S.
calls.bull_case: ~$20/share (~270% upside) on 2027E $1.4B sales re-rating to 4x P/S (2024 level; hit 5x in 2021).
calls.bear_case: League/data-rights renewal costs could compress margins; Sportradar and new tech threaten the moat; the flywheel must convert into sustained cash flow (mgmt guides 60% FCF conversion by 2028).
